$comment: Every kid-facing sentence (PLAN_V2 §7.10): keys → sentences of ≤ 12 words, reading age 7. Placeholders are {name}. Raw codes never reach the DOM. Owned by lane F; keys are referenced by the core (reason_key, summary_key, message_key, rel_key, note_key) and by Python (warning/error events, HTTP error bodies).

messages.norm.tidy_lines: I smoothed {n} wobbly lines so you won't trip.
messages.norm.straightened: I smoothed this wobbly line so you won't trip.
messages.norm.ramp: This bump is now a gentle ramp you can run up.
messages.norm.gap_closed: Two lines almost touched, so I joined them.
messages.norm.seam_joined: I joined your ground across the two sheets.
messages.norm.spikes_snapped: These spikes were hovering, so I stuck them on the {host}, pointing {facing}.
messages.norm.snapped: This was floating, so I set it on the {host}.
messages.norm.enemy_grounded: Your monster was floating, so I put its feet down.
messages.norm.oriented: These now point {facing}, away from where they sit.
messages.norm.pole_scenery: Your flag pole is scenery now, so it won't block you. Touch the flag to win!
messages.norm.goal_grounded: Your flag was floating, so I planted it on the ground.
messages.norm.oneway_platform: Thin floating lines are jump-through. Jump up through them!
messages.norm.solid_platform: This filled shape is solid, like a block.
messages.norm.not_solid: This doesn't block you. You can walk through it.
messages.norm.start_placed: You start here, on solid ground.
messages.norm.spawn_moved: You started next to spikes, so I moved your start {cells} squares.
messages.norm.patrol_trimmed: This monster walked too close to the start, so it walks less.
messages.norm.coin_from_dot: Your blue dot is a coin now.
messages.norm.deduped: Two of the same thing sat together, so I kept one.
messages.norm.behavior_fixed: This could not move that far, so it moves {cells} squares.
messages.norm.behavior_dropped: This had no room to move, so it stays still.
messages.norm.creature_fit: I made your monster's body fit its drawing.
messages.norm.goal_added: There was no flag, so I drew one in pencil.
messages.norm.key_to_coin: This key has no door yet, so it is a coin for now.
messages.norm.ground_stays: Your ground stays put, so you always have a floor.
messages.understand.decoration: That {what} is scenery. You can walk through it.
messages.understand.text_sign: "{text}" is your note. It's a sign, not a wall.
messages.understand.arrow_sign: Your arrow is a sign. It doesn't block you.
messages.understand.grouped: These pieces belong together, so they move together.
messages.understand.detached: I split your word from the ground, so it's not a wall.
messages.understand.walks: Your monster walks back and forth.
messages.understand.tree: Your tree is scenery. You can walk past it.
messages.repair.ledge_nudged: This ledge was {rise} rows up. The highest jump is {max}. I moved it {dy} down.
messages.repair.gap_nudged: This jump was {gap} squares. Running jumps go {max}. I moved this ledge {dx} closer.
messages.repair.nudged: I moved this {cells} squares so you can reach it.
messages.repair.wall_trimmed: This wall was too tall to jump. I made it {cells} shorter.
messages.repair.trimmed: I made this {cells} squares shorter so you fit.
messages.repair.extended: I made this {cells} squares longer so you can land.
messages.repair.runway: I made the run-up longer so you can get speed.
messages.repair.step_added: I added a little step so you can climb up.
messages.repair.spring_added: I added a spring to bounce you up there.
messages.repair.bonk_oneway: You bumped your head here, so now you jump through.
messages.repair.failed: I couldn't find a way across this {gap}-square gap without moving your drawing more than {max} squares.
messages.repair.required: Needed so the level can be finished.
messages.polish.checkpoint: I added a checkpoint so you don't replay {seconds} seconds.
messages.polish.coin_trail: Coins show the jump. Run before this gap!
messages.polish.big_coin: A big star waits here for brave players.
messages.polish.tune: This {what} is a little faster now.
messages.polish.par: Par time is {time}. Can you beat it?
messages.challenge.widen_gap: This gap is {cells} wider. Take a running jump!
messages.challenge.shrink_landing: This landing is smaller now. Land carefully!
messages.challenge.shift_platform: I moved this ledge a little to make it trickier.
messages.challenge.add_spikes: New spikes here. Jump over them!
messages.challenge.add_hazard: A {what} spins here now. Watch the timing!
messages.challenge.set_timer: Beat the clock: you have {seconds} seconds.
messages.challenge.reprise: Remember {setpiece}? Here it comes again, harder!
messages.kid.make_mine: This is yours now, drawn in your marker.
messages.kid.answer: Got it. I changed it like you said.
messages.flag.tight_window: This jump is very tight. Most players will fall here.
messages.flag.blind_jump: You can't see where you land from here.
messages.flag.leap_of_faith: You have to drop without seeing the bottom.
messages.flag.spawn_unsafe: Danger is right next to where you start.
messages.flag.invisible_lethal: Something hurts here, but you can't see it.
messages.flag.softlock: You can get stuck here with no way out.
messages.flag.long_segment: This part is long. A checkpoint would help.
messages.flag.head_bonk: You bump your head on this jump.
messages.flag.unreachable_drawn: Nobody can reach this. Did you mean to?
messages.flag.skippable_setpiece: Nobody will meet your spikes here.
messages.flag.trivial: This is very easy. Want to add a challenge?
messages.flag.long_flat: This long flat part has nothing to do.
messages.flag.dead_end: This path leads nowhere and takes a while.
messages.flag.entity_error: Something here could not be built.
messages.frontier.needs_run_up: This jump is {need} squares. A running jump does {max}. You have {have} squares of run-up.
messages.frontier.too_high: This ledge is {need} rows up. You can jump {max}.
messages.frontier.too_tall: This wall is {need} rows tall. You can jump {max}.
messages.frontier.goal_unreachable: Nobody can reach your flag yet.
messages.frontier.key_unreachable: Nobody can reach the key with the door shut.
messages.frontier.spawn_trapped: You start in a spot with no way out.
messages.reach.goes_up_to: This drawing goes up to {band} without changing what you drew.
messages.readout.pill: {band} · about 1 fall in {n} tries · bot {bot} · par {par}
messages.saw.sign: "{text}" is a sign; you can walk through it
messages.ask.which_door: Which door does this key open? Tap it.
messages.ask.which_flag_is_goal: Which flag is the finish? Tap it.
messages.ask.keep_or_fix: Keep it like you drew it, or fix it?
messages.ask.is_door: Is this black bar a door?
messages.card.required_lock: Needed so the level can be finished.
messages.why.gap: This jump was {gap} squares. Running you can jump {max}, so I moved the ledge {dx} closer.
messages.why.ledge: This ledge was {rise} rows up. You can jump {max} rows.
messages.note.greedy: I tidied your drawing and added a few helpers. Have fun!
messages.note.greedy_checkpoint: I added a checkpoint before the hard part.
messages.note.faithful: Here is your level, just like you drew it.
messages.toast.designer_polished: The designer polished your level: try it
messages.toast.designer_resting: The designer is resting; quick look only
messages.warning.looked_closer_skipped: I'll keep it as you drew it.
messages.warning.sheet_missing: Sheet {n} of {k} is missing: scan it or continue without it.
messages.warning.model_offline: Quick look only. More "Is this right?" questions.
messages.warning.budget_resting: The designer is resting; quick look only
messages.warning.design_late: The designer is still thinking. Here are ideas later.
messages.warning.duplicate_sheet: You scanned sheet {n} twice. I used the newest one.
messages.error.entity: I couldn't build the {thing} near {where}. I turned it off.
messages.error.build_failed: Something went wrong building your level. Try again?
messages.error.upload_failed: Your picture didn't arrive. Try again?
messages.error.no_drawing: I couldn't find a drawing. Try a brighter photo?
messages.error.rate_limited: Slow down a little, then try again.
messages.error.paper_missing: I couldn't find the paper corners. Show the whole sheet.
messages.publish.ok: Published! Share it with a friend.
messages.publish.unsolvable: Nobody can finish this yet. Fix the red part first.
messages.publish.entity_error: Something in your level is broken. I turned it off.
messages.publish.unanswered_ask: Answer my question first, then publish.
messages.publish.hash_mismatch: Your level changed. Let me check it again.
messages.publish.safety_flag: I can't share this one. Try a different drawing?
messages.publish.needs_goal: Your level needs a goal flag.
messages.publish.required_undone: You undid a needed fix. Keep it to publish.
messages.publish.unchecked: Published! It says "not checked yet" for now.
messages.vs.challenge: {name} cleared this in {time} with {deaths} deaths. Beat it!
messages.hint.goal_unreachable: Nobody can reach the flag yet.
messages.rules.becomes_unsolvable: This level can't be finished with the new rules.
messages.rules.needs_run: This level needs running to cross a gap.
messages.rules.needs_double_jump: This level needs the double jump.
messages.library.new_version: {name} changed. Old levels keep the old {name}.
messages.prompt.your_ground_wins: Your ground wins over the blue lines.
messages.editor.bake_fixes: Bake my fixes into the drawing
